newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria braced for more floods as waters rise.
newsitem.headline: Austria braced for more floods as waters rise.

text.p: Large parts of Austria were on flood alert on Friday as heavy rains swept across the country and swollen rivers threatened to burst their banks.
The situation was critical in the regions of Lower Austria, Styria, Salzburg and Upper Austria, weather experts said.
"If we get further downpours over the weekend, we could be looking at a flood catastrophe," meteorologist Manfred Bauer told state television.
In the northern province of Upper Austria, waters from the Trattnach river washed over a campsite near Grieskirchen where 24 teenagers were rescued by firemen, radio reported.
Elsewhere in Upper Austria, fire crews pumped out houses in Schaering and the railway station in Neumarkt im Hausruck was forced to close.
In the eastern province of Lower Austria, which last week suffered its worst floods this century, meteorologists feared high waters would wash along the Danube river from Bavaria.
Recent floods across Central Europe have killed 48 people in Poland and at least 46 in the Czech Republic.
